title: Bits emitted by a gate program
statement: Given a gate kind, a position $c\in\{0,1,2\}$, and a vector $v:\{0,1,2\}\to\mathbb N$, the emitted bit list is obtained by executing each instruction in the program for that gate and concatenating the resulting Boolean lists in order.
hypotheses_covered: A gate kind (AND, OR, or NOT)
A vector assigning a natural number to each of the three positions
